name: LValueData.hookNumber_eq_prod_factorial
summary: The highest polynomial of a one-row weight is the monomial ∏ X^{dg}, whose Fock pairing with itself is ∏ dg!.

steps.claim: The highest polynomial of the one-row weight is the monomial ∏_τ X_τ^{dg(τ)} (`highestPoly`, `tableauPoly`, minors of size one), and the Fock pairing of a monomial with itself is the product of the factorials of its exponents (`fockPairing_monomial`).
steps.lean:
(X.jetDeg τ).factorial := by rw [hookNumber, (?_ : highestPoly .. =
  ∏ y ∈ .image (⟨⟨·, 0, X.one_lt_card.le⟩, 0⟩) ⊤, .X y ^ X.jetDeg y.1.1), prod_X_pow,
  fockPairing_monomial, Finsupp.prod_indicator_index] <;> simp [highestPoly, tableauPoly, minor,
  @Fin.val_inj _ _ ⟨1, X.one_lt_card⟩, Function.Injective]; rfl
